claim_scope: synthetic statistical operating-characteristic calibration only; no measured lighting, Radiance, calibrated photometry or industry comparison

design.monte_carlo_adjustment: Bonferroni simultaneous one-sided Wilson score bounds over 24 null and 39 coverage method-scenario comparisons

conclusion: No method passed. Student-t was closest on false-superiority calibration but missed the 6% simultaneous upper-bound limit and the 94% coverage lower-bound requirement. Percentile bootstrap and studentized bootstrap-t failed more clearly. Unresolved lower bounds were kept visible and separately gated.

interpretation_examples.warning: Zero rejections on this discrete stress case is not evidence of a useful test when many outcomes are unresolved.

source_receipts.note: The downloadable standalone package includes a local source-mirrored comparator helper. In-repository execution resolves and hashes the repository comparator file, which may produce a different dependency digest.

limits: All outcomes are synthetic; no Radiance, DIALux, calibrated photometry or measured energy consumption is used.
Finite-interval coverage is conditional on a finite bound; unresolved outputs are reported and separately gated.
The methods are valid only to the extent their statistical assumptions and finite-sample behavior hold. These outcomes do not establish a method for deployment.
No method winner or SOTA claim is declared.
